Tesla operates in **Auto – Manufacturers** within Consumer Cyclical. The global auto industry is in a **late-cycle contraction**: US light-vehicle output fell ~1.3% in 2025 and is forecast to fall another ~2.8% in 2026 on tariff-related trade uncertainty (Atradius, Jul-2026), while China's domestic market is gripped by an EV price war (BYD cuts of up to 34%) that is collapsing margins industry-wide. - **EV adoption + price-parity convergence:** EV/ICE price premium roughly halved to ~10% (IEA Global EV Outlook 2026); a shrinking premium supports demand volumes and Tesla's addressable market.
